en: (I don't have anything to use for bait.)
(Coach Igarashi told me to go and fish something up. Looks like there's a good fishing spot over there.)
(Come to think of it, the coach wanted me to do some fishing. Now isn't the time, though.)
(This oughta be a good fishin' spot. Maybe I'll drop a line in for a bit.)
(All right, let's give it a shot.)
(Ain't got any bait to use.)
I want to see a <Color:8>ghost koi<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz!
(It sounds like Haruka wants me to catch a <Color:8>ghost koi<Color:Default>.)
I wonder if it would go for a <Color:8>Catnip Stick<Color:Default> or a <Color:8>Tuna Burger Set<Color:Default>?
Akihiko, are ya really serious? You're really gonna quit comedy?
Haruo, I'm telling ya. My mind's made up, and ya can't sway me!
But how can ya give up on our dream like that!? We've been a duo for four years now. You're just gonna throw that all away!?
It's not like I wanna throw it all away, but think about it! Do ya really think we got a shot at makin' it all the way?
Yeah, I do! I believe in us! We're gonna make it real big someday! That's why we've been working so hard for these past four years, isn't it!?
Well, great for you. I don't believe it anymore. We haven't had a glimmer of hope in four years.
We did hundreds of auditions, but we didn't get called back for a single one.
Okay, yeah, that might be true, but if ya work on being a better straight man, and I can work on being a better funny man...
But that's what we've been doin' for four years, and it hasn't happened yet! We ain't getting any younger, ya know!
But do ya have to quit right now? We have an audition in a couple of minutes! Why can't ya wait to see how that goes first!?
I've got some really great material this time! All ya gotta do is come back with some great retorts!
My mom found me a lead on a good job. Sorry, man, but I'm on my way to the interview right now.
If I'm gonna quit comedy, now's the time to do it. I don't want my mom worryin' about me anymore, ya know? Goodbye, Haruo.
Oh, man. What am I supposed to do without a partner?
That's all right. We hope to see you again soon.
Welcome. Are you ready to order? What would you like to drink?
(Got no money...)
Thank you very much. Here is your bill.
I'm cravin' some <Color:8>Maguro Zanmai<Color:Default>.
(Looks like Riku's hungry for some <Color:8>Maguro Zanmai<Color:Default>.)
All right, time to dig in!
I'm gettin' kinda bored with the dating options 'round here. This neighborhood's so small I've already been practically everywhere.
Do you want to take a little trip next time?
Hey, that might be fun! I'd love t'go on a trip someplace way far away.
A trip someplace far away, huh? I haven't done that myself in quite some time.
Really? But like, didn't y'just move into town not too long ago? At least you're gettin' out more than me.
The only times I ever traveled far away was when I took field trips, all the way back in high school. I just wanna get out and travel, ya know?
There's no time like the present. Maybe you should find a travel agency and plan a trip.
That'd sure be nice! Seein' new places is always so much fun, and I like planning out different things to do.
But won't it help to know where it is you're going before y'go to a travel agency?
Not really. They can suggest different travel destinations depending on the time of the year.
No kiddin'? I mean, I've never been to a travel agency before, so I wouldn't know.
You can always get brochures from them without a full consultation. Just visit their office.
I'll do that! Thanks, Kiryu-san! I knew I could count on ya!
Heh, good.
Find more stuff to do locally. You must wind up going to the same places in town all the time, so check out different places once in a while.
Other places? Other places like where?
Hmm. Let me think.
You're still young, so maybe you haven't tried out entertainment for more mature adults?
You could try your hand at mahjong or pachinko. You probably walked past a bunch of those places without ever going inside, I bet.
Y'might be right. Heck, now that you mention it, there are places 'round this neighborhood here I've never been to.
See? So it might be worth looking for new experiences right here in your own backyard.
Yeah, that sounds doable! Maybe y'can take me to one of those places sometime, Kiryu-san.
Would you be traveling alone?
I mean I haven't thought it through that far. I was bein' spontaneous, y'know?
Why? Wanna come with me, Kiryu-san?
That wasn't exactly what I was getting at.
Oh, well all right. I mean, maybe a day trip by car or something would be fine, but I'd be scared of stayin' overnight someplace with you.
Whoa, hey. Do I strike you as that sort of guy?
Well, why else would y'ask somethin' like that?
Besides, if I wanted to take a break from work, I wouldn't go on vacation with a client. Geez.
You have a point.
I could go for the <Color:8>Hana Course<Color:Default>.
(Looks like Riku wants the <Color:8>Hana Course<Color:Default>.)
Ya know, Kiryu-san, I bet y'could eat a horse, huh?
Well, my appetite's not as big as when I was younger. But the food here in Hakata is really good, so I've been checking out as many restaurants as I can.
Wow, men can be such foodies! Checkin' out new hotspots all the time, eh?
You don't want to pick a lousy restaurant when you invite a lady out to dinner, after all.
Yeah, I'm happy t'let guys take me out for a nice meal, but I'm worried if I keep on goin' out I'll get fat, y'know?
Want to try something different next? I don't mind going for something a little lighter, if you're worried about it being too heavy.
Naw, it's fine! I just meant like if you're gonna take me to all sortsa restaurants, then I just gotta watch what I eat.
You don't have to feel obligated on my account. I'd hate for you to get fat because of me.
I'll make sure I work out t'make up for it! Don't y'worry about me, Kiryu-san!
Well, I'll try. But working out for each date sounds a bit strange.
Lotsa girls start out skinny as a rail at first, then put on the pounds while dating. Y'gotta make sure you don't get dumped for bein' fat!
Hey, that goes for us men too. I should watch my own weight as well.
You don't need to eat if you don't want to. Just because I'm eating something doesn't mean you need to force yourself to do the same.
What!? Then what am I s'posed to do? Just sit and stare until you're done eatin'?
If you're worried about getting fat, then maybe.
That's why a guy oughta be considerate. Taking his girl to a restaurant where she won't feel guilty about getting something to eat is the way t'go, in my book.
It's really mean for ya to expect me to sit with my tummy rumblin' while I watch y'eat, Kiryu-san!
Then I can share some of what I'm eating with you. That'll make sure you don't overeat.
It's okay to put on some weight. Guys like it if a girl looks healthy instead of scrawny.
No way, buster! Once y'pack on the pounds, they're impossible to drop.
I just make sure t'watch what I eat, 'cause it's way easier than trying to diet later!
Does that mean you're holding back now?
Hehe. Yeah, I'm actually pretty hungry. But I'll get by.
You really don't need to hold back. If you're hungry, just eat. It's fine.
Hey, Uncle Kaz? I'm hungry for some <Color:8>Hanamidori Mizutaki<Color:Default>.
(Haruka wants to have some <Color:8>Hanamidori Mizutaki<Color:Default>.)
But I wanted some <Color:8>Hanamidori Mizutaki<Color:Default>.
(I'm kinda full.)
Thank you very much for coming by. Please come again.
(Miyoshino. This place oughta get Tatsuya's attention.)
(Kaburaya, huh? I could tell Tatsuya about this place.)
(Daruma, huh? I could tell Tatsuya about this place.)
Shit... This dude's a beast...
Are we done? 'Cause I really would like to get going here.
Screw you, man. Dude, let's just go already!

My, my. Nicely done. I suppose that does merit a certain
measure of praise.
Praise? What happened to you jumping in and helping? Instead, you enjoyed a ringside view!

Naturally. That sort of dirty, menial labor is and should be
relegated to the lower classes. Surely you don't expect the nobility to sully their pristine hands?
The only thing remotely noble about you is your Heian-era costume... You some kind of comedian?

<Italic>I am nothing of the sort</Italic>! And do address me with the proper
honorifics, you writhing, squalid vermin. For I am the
glorious, most venerable Leo Ayanokoji!
It's written with the kanji for "lion," to be sure, but it's pronounced "Leo"! I wager you're impressed?
Let me get this straight. You really think you're a nobleman? And your name is, what, Leo the Lion?
Ahahaha! Dude, are you for real right now?

Don't you dare laugh at me! I am a descendant of the gods!
And I'll have you know, my father is the chairman of the
neighborhood association. I'd like to see you top that!
Oh man... *chuckle* How are you keeping a straight face this whole time? Have you even looked at yourself in the mirror?

Hmph! Insolent, and churlish! I am utterly appalled!
A feeble-minded peasant mocking one so great as I...
Okay, okay, calm down. Listen, how old are you?
I shall be 35 this revolution 'round the sun.

You're 35 and this is what you do? Are you married? Wait,
don't answer that⑬of course you're not. If I were a lady,
I'd run the other way at first sight.

Hmph. I simply haven't deigned to take a lover yet. When you
bear the status that I do, women will throw themselves at
your feet. So I can choose a wife whenever I wish.
Ah, I get it. Something traumatized you a long time ago, and you completely lost your marbles. Why didn't I realize that sooner.
Welp, that's my cue to exit. Bye now!
Come now! Won't you hear me out?
What is it you want? I'd really rather not be seen with you...

Have you forgotten my royal lineage? We noblemen have a rich
tradition of bestowing favors and feudal positions according
to the exploits of our loyal footsoldiers.

Huh? Wasn't that the samurai? I'm no history buff, but
I can't really picture the nobility having done much of
anything for the people.

Cease this slander at once! Why must you lip off that way?
I'm saying I will repay my debt, so shut up and accept my
generosity, you insect!
Wow... You're off the rails, man.
Hmph. Given that earlier spectacle, you probably think of me as a coward, don't you?
Yup, sure do.

Well, there is far more to me than meets the untrained eye!
For I am a weapons master, a living instrument of warfare!
You can use weapons?
Precisely. When it comes to instruments of war, I am proficient at any kind. It just so happened I had none on my person.
And how is this related to anything?
I'm saying I will accept you as my apprentice for weapons training! You should be on your hands and knees in gratitude.

Don't look so nonplussed, you oafish boor! Listen here.
I am usually around the TV tower, making my rounds.
I will allow you to come accept my teachings!

Yes, yes, thank you for your questionable guidance. Maybe
I'll show once I have some extra time.
Then make the time, you bumbling baseborn brute! Pah, you'll sing a different tune once you feast your wits on the wisdom I have to offer.
Just be sure to appear at some point in the near future! Understood?
(What the heck was his deal? Anyway, he mentioned he'd be at the TV tower. I could always visit... if I really have nothing better to do.)
Hey, I dare you to say that shit again! Whatever the hell it was!
I rightfully addressed you ignorant peasants as such. 'Twas a mere statement of fact!

Okay, I've heard enough out of this apron-wearing lunatic.
Let's kick his ass.
What a pity... Besot by their lower nature as commoners, two ruffians cross my path and bark their empty threats. Alas, I am forced to demonstrate my elegance at⑬ Hm?
Oh dear. Oh my. Did I perchance drop it during my travels?
What's the matter? Your "elegance" go running off somewhere? Probably the same place you left your fashion sense!
Ah⑬ You see, I seem to have forgotten my armaments, which, needless to say, are important.

Blow it out your ass, grandma! You can't just weasel your
way out of a confrontation after dunking on our intelligence!
Now, now. I assure you, I am no "grandma." I advise you to stay thy tongue, lest you expose even more of your plebeian dimness of wit.
